taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-27 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 778.8 | 7.70 | 7.70
2 | 383.0 | 6.79 | 14.49
3 | 335.8 | 7.76 | 22.25
4 | 620.2 | 37.49 | 59.74
5 | 5481.2 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-27
Curve type: QHA-type
Aquifer depth: 7.70 - 22.25 m (with potential fractured zone extending to 59.74 m)
Recommendation: Drill to a total depth of approximately 60 to 65 m to fully tap the saturated weathered layer and underlying fractured zone before terminating in the fresh resistive basement. Screen the primary low-resistivity weathered zone between 7.7 m and 22.3 m to optimize water yield.
